admission: read unchanged product runtime thresholds, per-cell 0.9 and geometric mean 0.95; original runtime cells and startup cells separately and together; all regressions reported
memory_metric: small native exec/fork launcher target wait4 peak RSS; Python parent high-water marks excluded
memory_order: same twelve cells; five repetitions each; left-rotate base/candidate/rust by repetition modulo three
order: original six cells then six startup cells; warmups base/candidate/rust then rust/candidate/base; all six permutations five times, seeded shuffle per cell
scope: finite runtime comparison only; no whole product or compilation/maintenance claim
stop_rule: one complete frozen series; any identity/order/output/exit/deadline failure invalidates and retains all observations; no post-result expansion or winner selection
timing: perf_counter_ns immediately before Popen to completed wait4; files opened before clock; output hash afterward
